en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a large ornate Renaissance-style brick building with many statues along its facade and tall windows; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand on a cobbled street with a horse‑drawn cart. In the distant background a tall church tower is visible. There is printed text at the bottom naming the city and building and handwritten cursive text across the sky and lower margin.
